name: documentation
title_zh: 把文档按 Diátaxis 四象限重新分诊归类
tagline_zh: 教程、指南、参考、解释总混成一锅粥？它帮你把每页文档对号入座，读者不再迷路，维护者不再头大。
tagline_en: Docs all mixed up? It sorts every page into tutorials, how-tos, reference, or explanation—so readers find their.
desc_en: Creates, structures, and reviews technical documentation following the Diátaxis framework (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation pages). Use when a user needs to write or reorganize docs, structure a tutorial vs. a how-to guide, build reference docs or API documentation, create explanation pages, choose between Diátaxis documentation types, or improve existing documentation structur
why_zh: 不是排版建议，是强制分类器：先判定文档意图，再套 Diátaxis 结构，从根上消灭“四不像”章节。
why_en: Not a style guide—a classifier that pins down each page's intent before structuring, killing the 'mutt' section at its root.
limit_zh: 只认 Diátaxis 四类，不处理营销文案、README 或代码注释；对已有文档只做重排不重写。
limit_en: Only Diátaxis's four types; ignores READMEs, marketing copy, code comments. Rearranges existing text, never rewrites; needs full text pasted—no repo.
